render_volume_projection — 3D render op

• Data kinds: voxel → image2d

• Call: import match3d; match3d.render_volume_projection(vol, azimuth=0.0, elevation=0.0, mode='xray', device='cpu') (or ops3d.get("render_volume_projection"))

• GPU: this op has a GPU path (device="cuda")

Usage

Project a voxel volume to 2-D from an arbitrary viewpoint (mode = xray = attenuation integral / mip = maximum). For DRR (X-ray) and world-model observations.
